mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_DRAKAN (73), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_DRAKAN = 54 (_enum.h:4204), so Monster55.bmd; the Great Drakan (75) wears it too. OpenMU Version095d Maps/Icarus.cs:258 names breed 73 'Drakan'. docs/icarus-port.md.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13621-13638, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_DRAKAN: Scale = 0.8f (the Great Drakan 1.0); NotRotateOnMagicHit; meshes 0, 3 and 4 NoneBlendMesh, 1 and 2 not -- which only says which meshes RenderCharacter's chrome passes run over. No BlendMesh: every mesh solid. Its effects, in game/play (kDrakanFigure): a blue BITMAP_LIGHT at 0.8 on each of its 21 stars bones (:8840-8865), as starlights in its blue; BITMAP_JOINT_THUNDER sub 7, 20 wide, along stars04-03-02-01 and stars12-11 each frame (:8852-8856), ours one or two a reference frame; Attack 1's Inferno at CheckAttackTime(11) (:1734-1757); Attack 2's bolt from its head to the target at CheckAttackTime(13) (:2123-2138), as a monster's Lightning. Left out: RenderCharacter's chrome-bright and chrome2-lightmap passes over meshes 1 and 2 (:8882-8888) and the five MODEL_PIERCING + 1 streaks Attack 1 drops round it (:1743-1754).
plus_from: Its chrome-bright pass: RenderCharacter's MONSTER_DRAKAN arm draws the body with RENDER_CHROME | RENDER_BRIGHT at Bright 1 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8882-8883) in RenderPartObjectBodyColor's (0.2, 0.2, 0.8) for MODEL_DRAKAN (ZzzObject.cpp:9037-9047): a +7 item's chrome in that blue. Its second, RENDER_CHROME2 | RENDER_LIGHTMAP, is left out.
rig_from: Exported with --actions=all, 7 actions, 59 bones; keys 13, 13, 13, 7, 7, 7, 7. Its death plays at 0.22 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3775-3781), in actions.json's action_overrides.
sheet_from: Data/Monster's drt02.OZJ (256 square, the black scaled serpent body traced in blue, 980 triangles), drt01.OZJ (256 square, blue plates traced in gold, 604), drt00.OZJ (64 square, the gold eye, 80), drt05.OZJ (24x16, a red glint, 8) and drt03.OZT (64 square, the black feathered mane, its alpha cutting 55%, 368), under a drakan_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the art: drt02 a dragon's black scales, chitin as Icarus's sky dragons' drr sheets; drt01 painted blue plate, painted_steel; drt03 a feathered mane, hair; drt00 and drt05 its eyes.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V and striping plate; the armour sets' cast grain instead, as the Tarkan monsters.
soft_alpha_from: drt03.OZT is drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest): the mane's feathers.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3775-3781: SetMonsterSound(..., 165, 165, 166, 166, 167): mDrakan1 to move, mDrakanAttack1 to attack, mDrakanDie to die. Wired as drakan_* in sounds.json.
